content.text: Most tutorials about building a digital store focus on the storefront. The storefront is the last thing you should configure. The backend is what makes the store work — and the backend is what most creators get wrong when they try to build without a clear sequence. In Stack 01, Google Apps Script serves as the backend Web App — it receives the NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction on-chain, logs the order to Google Sheets, and sends the delivery email via Gmail. In Stack 02, Cloudflare Workers replaces Apps Script with a faster, more scalable serverless backend that integrates natively with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-guide|Everything About]]-you-need-5|supabase]] for order storage and Resend for email delivery. Configure the backend first, set the webhook endpoint URL in NOWPayments second, build the storefront third, and test on mainnet fourth.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

COREMERCH's Sovereign Stacks are designed to work around platform restrictions, providing a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that allows digital creators to collect payments for their products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or other conventional payment platforms. By using Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, or other free hosting services, and combining them with NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, digital creators can build a fully operational online store with complete control over their infrastructure. This approach is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure solution that gives digital creators the freedom to collect payments in their preferred way.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you need to have a digital product to sell, a payment method preferred by your customers, and a hosting service such as Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. You will also need to set up a NOWPayments account, which provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. In addition, you will need to have a basic understanding of web development and configuration. If you need help with setup or deployment, COREMERCH offers a range of products, including the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Complete Builder Kit, which can be purchased at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you need to configure NOWPayments to work with your preferred payment method and Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages to host your digital products. You will also need to set up a file delivery system, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to deliver your digital products to customers. Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can test it on the mainnet to ensure that it is working correctly.
You can deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free using COREMERCH's Sovereign Stacks.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up and tested your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live and start processing transactions. To do this, you will need to deploy your Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages site, configure your payment settings, and test your payment and delivery pipeline. Stack 01 deployment takes 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, while Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. With COREMERCH's Sovereign Stacks, you can be up and running quickly and easily.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is up and running, you can scale your infrastructure to meet the demands of your business. To do this, you can upgrade your hosting service to a more robust plan, add more payment methods, and increase the storage capacity of your file delivery system. You can also use COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, to help you scale your infrastructure quickly and easily.

Configure NOWPayments to work with your preferred payment method. Set up a file delivery system, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to deliver your digital products to customers. Deploy your site and test it on the mainnet to ensure that it is working correctly. Upgrade your hosting service to a more robust plan as needed.
